'''''Ace in the Hole: A Cockpit's-Eye View of Turbulent Times''''' was a memoir written by former [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] leader [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. In it, he described his experiences although many stories were not included due to their classified nature.<ref name="mk" />
